title: Senior Frontend Engineer
body:
Bellwether makes scheduling software for clinics.

Requirements
- 5 years of TypeScript and React in production
- Experience with accessibility standards and WCAG
- Comfortable writing and reviewing tests

Nice to have
- Design system experience
- GraphQL

The salary range for this role is $150,000 - $185,000 USD per year.
Full-time, remote within the United States.
